observations: Rulings the task asked for, all accepted as shipped-consistent: काम सौंपना for Delegates (it matches the shipped section title ui.agents.detail.section.delegation = 'काम सौंपना और प्रयास', and the call site is a boolean capability fact — profile.delegate in agent-detail.tsx:173 — so the sidecar's 'no verb' rule holds); पाएँ for Get (shipped पाएँ in ui.hub.subscriptions.subscribe_description, ui.onboarding.search.row.get_your, ui.common.account.*); एजेंट हब (shipped ui.agents.dialogs.create.hub_link, ui.agents.navigation.*); कॉन्फ़िगरेशन रन (shipped ui.agents.config.status.attached, ui.agents.detail.alert.conflict_body); माँगें (shipped 13× incl. the sibling empty state 'नीचे एक माँगें, या खुद एक जोड़ें।').

{when} अपडेट किया गया without को is CORRECT: the shipped convention is को for an absolute date (ui.hub.teams.detail.updated = '{date} को अपडेट किया गया') and no postposition for a relative phrase, which is what the slot always carries. Composed through the real ICU runtime: '3 दिन पहले अपडेट किया गया', '0 सेकंड पहले अपडेट किया गया', '3 दिन पहले बनाया गया' — all natural and created/updated stay distinguishable.

Nasalisation matches the shipped catalogue exactly: ँ in पाएँ/दिखाएँ/बताएँ/माँगें (counts at parent 73af0b6855: 8/32/1/11 values; the delta adds 1/2/4/2) and ं in करें/जोड़ें. Zero ं spellings (पाएं/दिखाएं/बताएं/मांगें) exist at parent or now, and the new values add none. Nukta is the same decomposed फ + U+093C as shipped कॉन्फ़िगरेशन (code points compared). No ZWJ/ZWNJ in any new value.

The em dash in ask.body_agent is not a finding: the catalogue used U+2014 in 149 values at parent 73af0b6855 (150 now, +1 here), including adjacent ui.agents.config.status.attached and ui.agents.detail.alert.conflict_body.

Quotes “ ” around {name} follow the style guide (the English source's ASCII " is correctly localized); English '...' is rendered as U+2026 in all three placeholders and in retrying. No ASCII quote or '...' breach exists anywhere in these seven files, new or pre-existing.

Tail-truncation judgement (not a finding): card.updated renders inside

and the team recency inside , so Hindi's time-first order puts the verb where an ellipsis lands first. The sidecar explicitly sanctions time-first order ('One whole sentence, so a language that puts the time before the verb can reorder it'), the alternative verb-only tails (…अपडेट / …बना) would be more terse but less natural, and the created/updated pair already differs at the verb, so no change is requested.

Source gaps seen while checking call sites (NOT translation defects, and outside this delta): (1) ui.hub.pages.card.get's accessible name is a hardcoded English literal — aria-label={`Download ${displayName}`} at agent-card.tsx:414 — although its sidecar says the accessible name is 'a separate message'; no catalogue key for it exists, so the hi card's one localized visual label still sits on an English aria-label. (2) The agent meta line hardcodes the English literal 'Specialist' next to the newly translated काम सौंपना (agent-detail.tsx:174) — the same meta line.

काम सौंपना sits as the middle fact of 'हब · काम सौंपना · Specialist' (agent-detail.tsx:170-178; facts joined with ' · ' at line 178 inside a flex-wrap div at 177): two words instead of one, which the line absorbs by wrapping as the sidecar anticipated; the line is a wrapping

with no fixed width or height (agent-detail.tsx:178), so the extra word costs height at a wrap, never a clipped label.
